verdict.rationale: Workable's API uses granular per-endpoint scopes such as r_jobs, r_candidates, w_candidates, w_members and r_account, and its docs say scopes can be enabled through the Settings > Integrations section, so least-privilege tokens appear possible. The pack does not show the token-generation flow where scopes are chosen, and nothing ties credentials to agents or the MCP server. Missing for 10: documented scope selection at token creation, agent- or MCP-specific credential scoping, token expiry/revocation details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
